notes: Titles and queries for the guides and Baedekers named in PLAN.md (Data workstream, step 1).
archive_org.queries are Lucene queries for advancedsearch.php; 'mediatype:texts' is added by run.ts.
gallica.queries are CQL for the SRU endpoint; periodical records with gallica.issues=true are expanded to their issues for the years listed.
HathiTrust's Bib API looks volumes up by identifier only: open hathitrust.catalog_search in the catalog UI and paste the OCLC numbers, record numbers or htids found into the lists.
title_must_match: every listed word (accent- and case-folded; alternatives separated by '|') must appear in a result's title, otherwise the result is dropped as noise.
Years are filtered after the search: results dated outside 'years' are dropped; undated results are kept with a note.
Entries after le-temps were added from the per-game DATA_NEEDS.md files (games/*/design/); each entry notes which game needs it.

Le Temps (Paris daily) — dated events

entries.title: Whitaker's Almanack (1913, 1914, 1915)
entries.notes: Requested by all three DATA_NEEDS files: British postal and telegraph rates, bank holidays and quarter days, foreign money tables (parities), office hours, the Secret Service vote line in the estimates.

entries.title: The Statesman's Year-Book (1913, 1914)
entries.notes: C01 and C04: budgets and their year starts, currencies and parities, police and registration institutions by country.

entries.title: Baedeker, Berlin and its Environs (1912 or nearest) / Berlin und Umgebung
entries.notes: C04: Berlin lodging and rent terms, police registration practice for visitors and residents, office hours. C07 and C01: Berlin prices.

entries.title: Journal officiel de la République française (July–September 1914)

queries: dc.title all "Journal officiel de la République française"

entries.notes: C07 and C01: dated decrees (mobilisation, state of siege, moratorium on bills and deposits, passport and residence rules for foreigners). Look up single dated issues with the Issues service.

entries.title: The London Gazette (July–September 1914)
entries.notes: C01 and C04: Orders in Council under the Aliens Restriction Act, bank holiday extensions and the moratorium proclamations. Full runs are at thegazette.co.uk, which is not an allowed host; request it if archive.org lacks the 1914 issues.

entries.title: International telegraph tariffs (Bureau international de l’Union télégraphique; nomenclature and tariffs, 1912–1914)
entries.notes: C07 and C01: per-word rates between the game countries, and service hours of telegraph offices; Whitaker's gives the British side.

entries.title: Berlin police registration ordinances (Polizeiverordnung über das Meldewesen, as in force 1913–1914)
entries.notes: C04 (and C07): registration deadlines for lodgers and residents, the Abmeldung with forwarding address, who files the slip (landlord or lodger). Prussian collections of police ordinances are also candidates.

entries.title: R. Fritzsches Kursbuch für Sachsen, das übrige Mitteldeutschland, Böhmen und Schlesien
entries.notes: SLUB Dresden (P-E012, P-009): Winter 1913/14, Summer 1914 (the D2 pilot anchor for Berlin – Dresden – Bodenbach – Prague – Vienna) and Winter 1914/15. SLUB's search pages have a bot check, so issue ids are listed by hand; the series runs from summer 1911 (…-19110001) to winter 1915/16 (…-19150002).
